name: Tuesday Grind
summary: Tight handles, quick reads, crafty finishes, then shots on tired legs.

drills.name: Pocket Pickup Series
drills.summary: Hide the ball in your pocket, then snap it out to attack.
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with the ball on your right hip.
Dribble and pull the ball back into your hip pocket on every bounce for 30 seconds.
Add a snap crossover out of the pocket every third dribble.
Switch to your left hand and repeat.
Finish with 30 seconds alternating hands, pocket to crossover.

drills.name: Finger Flash Drives
drills.summary: Read your partner's signal fast and make the right play.
steps: Set a cone at the top of the key. Your partner stands under the rim.
Dribble at the cone. As you reach it, your partner flashes one, two or three fingers.
One finger: drive right for a layup. Two: drive left for a layup. Three: pull up for a jumper.
Your partner rebounds and passes back. Go again right away.
Partner flashes later each rep to make you read faster.

drills.name: Same-Foot Finishes
drills.summary: Jump off the same-side foot to throw off the shot blocker's timing.
steps: Start at the right wing. Take two hard dribbles toward the rim.
Jump off your right foot and finish with your right hand off the glass.
Do 5 reps, then switch to the left wing: left foot, left hand.
Next round, finish with the opposite hand on the same-foot jump.
Keep each finish soft, high off the glass.

drills.name: Sprint-Back Elbows
drills.summary: Make game-speed jumpers when your legs are burning.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Sprint with the ball to half-court, touch the line, and dribble back hard.
Pull up at the right elbow and shoot. Get your own rebound.
Repeat, pulling up at the left elbow next.
Count your makes. Try to beat it next week.
